> I read this as implementing the macOS AppKit local key-event monitor for unshifted Cmd+W tab closure while preserving non-macOS behavior, ensuring clean compilation, and reporting RED→GREEN test evidence and check results - verify the pure predicate unit test, validate monitor lifecycle and event swallowing, and report the command outcomes.

### 1. Changed Paths
- `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`: Added `objc2-app-kit = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "NSEvent"] }` under `[target.'cfg(target_os = "macos")'.dependencies]`.
- `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`: Added pure shortcut predicate helpers (`is_unshifted_cmd_w_modifiers`, `is_unshifted_cmd_w_characters`, `is_unshifted_cmd_w`), native `NSEventMask::KeyDown` local monitor installation during macOS app setup emitting `menu_close_tab` and returning null (`ptr::null_mut()`) on match, process-lifetime retention (`std::mem::forget`), and unit regression tests covering modifier and key boundaries.

---
